an8.52:1.1: 52 ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an8.52:1.2: athakho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an8.52:1.3: katihi nu kho bhante dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu bhikkhunovādako sammannitabboti.
an8.52:2.1: aṭṭhahi kho ānanda dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu bhikkhunovādako sammannitabbo
an8.52:2.3: idhānanda bhikkhu sīlavā hoti …pe… samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu
an8.52:2.5: ubhayāni kho panassa pātimokkhāni vitthārena svāgatāni honti suvibhattāni suppavattitāni suvinicchitāni suttaso anubyañjanaso
an8.52:2.6: kalyāṇavāco hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpaniyā
an8.52:2.7: paṭibalo hoti bhikkhunīsaṅghassa dhammiyā kathāya sandassetuṃ samādapetuṃ samuttejetuṃ sampahaṃsetuṃ
an8.52:2.9: na kho panetaṃ bhagavantaṃ uddissa pabbajitāya kāsāyavatthanivasanāya garudhammamajjhāpannapubbo hoti
an8.52:2.11: imehi kho ānanda aṭṭhahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu bhikkhunovādako sammannitabboti.
